source: GDD 5b.1 - The Shadow Past Origin & Trait System

origins.label: Gutter-Alchemist of Greyport
origins.desc: +2 INT, +1 LCK, -1 STR; volatile sulfur pouch
origins.passive: Auto-identifies potions, poisons and boiler PSI pressures; synthesises Acid Vials to melt Grade-3 brass locks silently.

origins.label: Velvet-Tongued Confidence Man
origins.passive: Social Disguise Stealth: stolen Guard Tabards, Monk Robes and Footman Tailcoats let Kaelen walk past patrols in plain sight.

origins.label: Dockside Pit-Cutthroat
origins.passive: Heavy and unarmed strikes deal +25% stagger; intimidates minor brigands into surrendering their coin purses without combat.

origins.label: Occult Reliquary Fence
origins.desc: +2 LCK, +1 INT, -1 AGI; curse penalty reduction
origins.passive: Senses hidden doors and cursed relics within 8 m; halves Max HP/STA penalties from Liber Cutis and Genie Bargains.

traits.label: Compulsive Magpie
traits.desc: +25% Silver Moons and gem find, but passing within 2.5 m of unlooted gilded items triggers an [INT 11] impulse check.

traits.label: Glass-Eyed Skeptic
traits.desc: +30% Magic/Illusion Resist and passive shimmer on false walls, but cannot receive Chapel blessings.

traits.label: Clockwork Ear
traits.desc: +20% wider timing windows on lockpicking, parrying and rhythm trials, but +50% sonic/stagger damage taken.

traits.label: Claustrophile of the Vents
traits.desc: +30% crouch speed and +2 STA/s regen in vents and darkness, but -10% Dodge in brightly lit open arenas.
